page.title: Space Agent
page.introA: Space Agent lives in the browser runtime itself, so the agent can work inside the same interface it is changing.
page.introB: Instead of being trapped inside a fixed product surface, it can build pages, tools, widgets, and workflows directly into the running workspace.
page.highlight1Body: Ask for a new tool or workflow and the agent can extend the workspace from within the system itself.
page.highlight2Title: Built for personal and shared use
page.highlight2Body: Start with your own layer, then grow into shared group spaces, tools, and admin control when the scope expands.
page.personalityHelp: These instructions are loaded from and saved to your user prompt-include file.
page.personalityPlaceholder: Write tone, standing preferences, or durable instructions for your agent here.
page.personalityFootnote: Stored in ~/conf/personality.system.include.md. Readable *.system.include.md files are injected into the agent system prompt.
